Card Q&A.a: No, the the trashed card is public information. "Trash [...] without looking" means that you must choose a card to trash from your opponent's hand without looking at the front of the cards in their hand.
Card Q&A.q: Is the card trashed by this card's [On Deletion] effect also private information?

Effect: [On Play][When Attacking] Trash the top 3 cards of your deck.
[Your Turn] This Digimon gets +1000 DP for every 3 cards in your trash.
[On Deletion] Trash 1 card in your opponent's hand without looking.
